# DSH Studio v0.9.26

## New features

- Bounded workspace filename/path search, Back/Forward history, keyboard shortcuts and wrapped, numbered text previews. The preview shows up to 5,000 lines; copying retains the complete loaded file.
- Workspace-scoped local notes with autosave, persistent draft checkpoints, restart recovery, revision conflicts, separate copies and confirmed discard actions.
- Per-file unified/side-by-side Git review with old/new line numbers, quoted UTF-8 paths and binary/metadata-only change navigation.

## Changes and security

- Notes use atomic application-owned storage and protect unfinished edits during workspace switching, close, updates and renderer recovery. Stale roots, revisions and draft confirmations fail without overwriting data.
- Bound file traversal and note storage; exclude dependency/build trees and links. Note editing loads on demand within the existing 450 KiB entry budget. Public Protocol 3 and Host Protocol 1 remain unchanged.

## Fixes and polish

- Refresh shared typography, control sizes, field corners, checkboxes and raised neutral segmented selections in both themes.
- Remove native-owned timestamps from note write requests so existing notes and recovered drafts save correctly; normalize Windows Git path separators to identify the current worktree.
- Add guarded discard actions and update bilingual guides and 14 actual desktop screenshots.
- Gate the adopted-process test's descendants on completed job assignment to remove a Windows fixture race and test the documented reclamation guarantee.
- Resolve worktree root aliases before comparison so macOS identifies the selected worktree correctly.

## Verification

- 717 frontend, 587 regular Rust and 158 packaging tests passed; tracked frontend logic reached 99.20% line coverage. The additional runtime oracle checked 4,716 ranges. Type/lint/Clippy, build budget, ACL/contracts, Tauri pairing, accessibility and documentation checks passed.
- Actual Windows WebView checks covered both themes and three viewport sizes, note conflicts/restart recovery/close protection, file previews/search, per-file review, prompt/session/backup flows, updates, Harness transitions, PTYs, remote controls and presentation editing. Managed Node 24.21 reinstallation completed after isolated Harness startup verification while the UI remained responsive.
- OS file pickers, paid model calls and physical macOS/Linux GUI were not locally verified. Release CI continues cross-platform cold-runtime, build, installation and resource acceptance before publication.

## Installation

- Upgrade over v0.9.25 without resetting runtime, profiles, sessions or preferences. Project notes are separate from personal-library JSON backups; include the application data directory in backups.
- Lite packages support Windows x64, Linux x64 and macOS Apple Silicon/Intel/Universal. Full/Offline packages support Windows x64, Linux x64 and macOS Apple Silicon or Intel. macOS Universal is Lite-only; choose the matching architecture-specific Full/Offline package for offline installation. Fully extract Windows portable packages and retain dist/ beside the executable. Application updates use signed manifests.
